source: 04 · The Night [Name]_s Bed Became a Boat — APPROVED v2.docx
title_template: The Night [Name]'s Bed Became a Boat
back_blurb: Wash, pyjamas, teeth, one story, little light. Then [Name]'s big bed sets sail, past pillow islands and a yawning whale, all the way to morning.
honesty_line: Illustrated from [Name]'s photo and checked by a person before print.
spine_title: The Night [Name]'s Bed Became a Boat
cover_art: [Name] in the story's key scene from spread 1 — face large and front-on; upper third calm for the title. Bedroom, daytime. A low big bed with clear floor around it; [Name] sits on it with a picture book, [Carer] beside for a cuddle

title_page.spot: Small spot of the bed. No child on this page.

anchor.description: The bedroom set, built once; [Object] as first mate on every spread. The bed never leaves the room and is never on real water.

must_not_show: monsters, no scary dark corners, no adult in the child's bed, no child leaving the bed, no bouncing, no high bed or unsafe rails, no threats. Night spreads: face check at full brightness before the night grade

spreads.text: This is [Name]'s big bed. In the day, it is just a bed, for cuddles and for books. "Tonight," says [Carer], "it sails."
spreads.setting: Bedroom, daytime. A low big bed with clear floor around it
spreads.art: Bedroom, daytime. A low big bed with clear floor around it; [Name] sits on it with a picture book, [Carer] beside for a cuddle
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above the bed — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: First, a wash. Splish, splash. Warm water on hands and face. A soft towel. Pat, pat. "A sailor is clean," says [Carer].
spreads.art: Bathroom basin. [Name] washes face; towel ready
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Then pyjamas. One arm in. Two arms in. One leg, two legs. Buttons… done! "A sailor is warm," says [Name].
spreads.setting: Bedroom. [Name] does up pyjama buttons, proud
spreads.art: Bedroom. [Name] does up pyjama buttons, proud
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Then teeth. Brush, brush, top and bottom, round and round, back and front. Spit! Splosh. "A sailor has shiny teeth," says [Carer].
spreads.setting: Bathroom. [Name] brushes teeth with [Carer] crouched beside, helping
spreads.art: Bathroom. [Name] brushes teeth with [Carer] crouched beside, helping; mirror shows nothing readable
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper left — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Into the boat. [Object] is the first mate. [Carer] sits on the edge and reads one story. Just one. The best one.
spreads.art: [Name] in bed with [Object]; [Carer] on the edge reading a picture book (blank cover)
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Big light off. Little light on. [Carer] leaves the door just the way [Name] likes it. The room is soft and gold.
spreads.setting: Big light off, little light on, warm gold light. Two variants with the same text: a night-light by the bed, or a landing light through the door. Door drawn to the family's setting
spreads.art: Big light off, little light on, warm gold light. Two variants with the same text: a night-light by the bed, or a landing light through the door. Door drawn to the family's setting
spreads.calm_zone_note: Lighter wall area near the little light — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: [Carer] gives one kiss. "[Exit line]. See you in the morning." Then [Carer] goes, and the little light keeps watch.
spreads.art: [Carer] kisses [Name]'s forehead; then at the door, calm face
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: [Name] closes [their] eyes. The duvet goes swish, like the sea. Swish, swash. Slowly, slowly, the bed begins to sail.
spreads.art: [Name], eyes closed, smiling; duvet folds become gentle waves at the edges; room still visible
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Past an island made of pillows. Past a whale with a big, slow yawn. A lighthouse blinks. It looks a lot like the little light.
spreads.setting: Imagined scene around the real bed: pillow island, a gentle yawning whale, a lighthouse shaped like the little light. The bed stays in the room
spreads.art: Imagined scene around the real bed: pillow island, a gentle yawning whale, a lighthouse shaped like the little light. The bed stays in the room; no real water
spreads.calm_zone_note: Sky — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: In the night, [Name] wakes. The bed feels new. "[Carer]?" [Carer] comes to the door. "I'm here." [Name] hugs [Object]. "I'm still the captain." Eyes close again.
spreads.setting: Night. [Name] sitting up in bed, calm, hugging [Object]
spreads.art: Night. [Name] sitting up in bed, calm, hugging [Object]; [Carer] in the doorway, soft light behind. No adult in the bed
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: The boat sails on, slow and quiet. Above, the stars are out. Below, the sea is soft as a duvet. Swish, swash.
spreads.setting: Gentle starry sea around the bed, the room still visible at the edges
spreads.art: Gentle starry sea around the bed, the room still visible at the edges; [Name] asleep
spreads.calm_zone_note: Stars — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Morning! Sun on the curtains. Birds outside. The boat is a bed again, and the captain is home, snug as anything.
spreads.art: Morning sun through curtains; [Name] stretching in bed, smiling
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: [Carer] comes in, smiling. "Good morning, Captain!" [Name] grins. What's for breakfast? Toast? Porridge? [Name] thinks very hard. Toast, please!
spreads.setting: [Carer] at the door, smiling, saluting playfully
spreads.art: [Carer] at the door, smiling, saluting playfully; [Name] sits up grinning
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Tonight the bed sails again. Wash. Pyjamas. Teeth. Story. Little light. Then one kiss, and the same words. All aboard, Captain.
spreads.setting: Evening again. [Name] by the bed with [Object], ready. The five routine icons are set in code under the text, not drawn
spreads.art: Evening again. [Name] by the bed with [Object], ready. The five routine icons are set in code under the text, not drawn
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

parent_spread.you_could_say: "[Exit line]. See you in the morning." The same words every night.
parent_spread.try_together: "What will your boat sail past tonight?"
parent_spread.in_real_life: If [Name] wakes in the night, offer comfort and use your familiar goodnight words to help [Name] settle back into bed.
parent_spread.read_it_again: Read this story a few nights in a row, and once more just before the day itself.
